summary: Implemented GeneralizedWassersteinDiceLoss in monai/losses/dice.py (after GeneralizedDiceLoss, before the alias block), added the generalized_wasserstein_dice alias, and exported the class from monai/losses/__init__.py. Added tests/test_generalized_wasserstein_dice_loss.py with the binary 2D and empty class cases. Nothing was run and nothing was committed, per instructions. Not covered by tests: the batch-of-two coupling case (expected 0.333), numpy-vs-tensor equivalence, max-2 normalisation, and the non-square ValueError. Note: a numpy matrix produces a float64 loss because the matrix dtype is kept.
